title: OlcsaHitDelay
description: OlcsaHitDelay is a lightweight utility that lets you customize combat speed by adjusting player invulnerability ticks.
body:
# OlcsaHitDelay

**OlcsaHitDelay** is a lightweight and efficient utility plugin designed to give server owners full control over combat pacing by modifying player invulnerability frames (No Damage Ticks).

Whether you want to create a fast-paced "NoCooldown" PvP environment or a more tactical combat system, this plugin provides an easy solution.

### ✨ Features
* **Custom Combat Speed** – Easily modify the delay between hits to suit your server's needs.
* **Global Sync** – Automatically applies the hit delay to all online players and new arrivals.
* **Join Notifications** – Optional, customizable join message with a clickable link to the plugin's official page.
* **Real-time Configuration** – Change settings on the fly without needing to restart your server.
* **Lightweight & Fast** – Optimized code that won't impact server performance.

### 🔧 Commands
* `/olcsahitdelay setdelay <ticks>` – Set the maximum invulnerability time for players.
* `/olcsahitdelay joinmessage <true/false>` – Toggle the plugin's join notification.
* `/olcsahitdelay reload` – Reload the configuration and apply changes immediately.

### 🛡️ Permissions
* `olcsahitdelay.admin` – Allows access to all administrative commands.

✔️ **OlcsaHitDelay** is the perfect choice for server owners who want to fine-tune their PvP mechanics with simplicity and precision.
